column1: # Nine BRAND-NEW reactions that aren't in the ModelSEED biochemistry; they
# transport a single compound from cytosol (c) -> stroma (d). The original
# code synthesises each at template-generation time with synthetic IDs
# These don't fit the "modify an existing role/complex" pattern because there
# is no role and no underlying MS reaction. To make them curator-managed we
# need a NEW action that defines a brand-new template-only reaction.
#   NEW reaction <synthetic_id> <home_cpt>      - PROPOSED: declare a new
#   REASSIGN name "Display name"                - PROPOSED: human-readable name
#   ADD    reagent cpd coeff <cpt>              - same as elsewhere, but here
# Each block of three lines below defines one transport reaction. The "enzyme"
# column carries a synthetic role name "Glucosinolate Transport (<cpd>)" so
# the rows have a stable key for future re-curation; the apply pipeline will
# create a matching template-only complex entry (see README).
